en_title: Sony Channels '90s Transparent Trend With New Prism Collection of DualSense Controllers and PS5 Covers
cn_title: 索尼Prism系列重拾透明设计
subtitle: 重返90年代
opus_summary: 索尼公布Prism系列透明DualSense手柄及配套PS5外壳，提供橙、绿、灰三种配色。该系列将于11月10日开放预购，明年2月4日正式发售。

paragraphs.en: PlayStation is bringing back the '90s transparent trend with the Prism Collection, a spread of DualSense controllers and matching PS5 covers in three new colorways.
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation推出Prism系列，以三款全新配色的DualSense手柄及配套PS5外壳，重现上世纪90年代的透明设计风潮。

paragraphs.en: Preorders open on November 10 at 10am local time ahead of the collection's full launch next year. The Prism Collection DualSense controllers, available in Flare Orange, Emerald Green, and Graphite Gray, are releasing globally with a recommended retail price (RRP) of $84.99 USD (€84.99/£74.99). Matching PS5 console covers have an RRP of $74.99 USD (€74.99/£64.99).
paragraphs.cn: 该系列将于当地时间11月10日上午10点开放预购，明年正式发售。Prism系列DualSense手柄提供耀橙色（Flare Orange）、翡翠绿（Emerald Green）和石墨灰（Graphite Gray）三种配色，将在全球发售，建议零售价为84.99美元(约合人民币567元)、84.99欧元(约合人民币631元)／74.99英镑(约合人民币665元)。配套PS5主机外壳的建议零售价为74.99美元(约合人民币500元)、74.99欧元(约合人民币557元)／64.99英镑(约合人民币576元)。

paragraphs.en: A PlayStation blog post offers a closer look at the new see-through designs. The images are accompanied by insights from the design team, who were particularly “excited to bring a transparent appearance to PS5.”
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation博客发布了一篇文章，详细展示这些全新的透明设计。除了图片，文章还介绍了设计团队的想法，团队尤其「为能给PS5带来透明外观而兴奋」。

paragraphs.en: "We wanted to bring back the iconic see-through trend of the late '90s in a fresh, modern way that complements the PS5’s industrial design," said PlayStation designer Leo Cardoso. The blog post also highlights that the see-through casing offers a “closer look at the design and craftsmanship behind our DualSense controllers and PlayStation 5 consoles.”
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation设计师Leo Cardoso表示：「我们希望以新颖、现代的方式，重现90年代末标志性的透明设计风潮，与PS5的工业设计相得益彰。」博客文章还强调，透明外壳让人能够「更近距离地欣赏DualSense手柄和PS5主机的设计与工艺」。

paragraphs.en: Fellow designer Satoshi Aoyagi describes the three colors the team chose to showcase the transparent mould: “A vibrant orange that subtly takes on a rosy hue where the transparent material overlaps, a deep hunter green that gains depth through its transparency, and a cool-toned storm gray.”
paragraphs.cn: 另一位设计师Satoshi Aoyagi介绍了团队为展现透明外壳而选择的三种颜色：「鲜亮的橙色，在透明材质重叠处隐约泛出玫瑰色调；深沉的猎人绿，透明效果让颜色更有层次；以及冷色调的风暴灰。」

paragraphs.en: The full Prism Collection will be available to preorder from PlayStation Direct and select retailers starting November 10, with the full release scheduled for February 4.
paragraphs.cn: Prism全系列将于11月10日起在PlayStation Direct及指定零售商处开放预购，定于2月4日正式发售。

paragraphs.en: Sony has released over a dozen DualSense color variants in the PS5 generation on top of limited-edition controllers tied to specific game releases like Astro Bot and Death Stranding .
paragraphs.cn: 在PS5世代，索尼除了推出《宇宙机器人》《死亡搁浅》等游戏的限定版手柄，还发布了十多种配色的DualSense手柄。

paragraphs.en: While the company is expanding the reach of its hardware collaborations, like a new DualSense controller with Kpop star Lisa , its most popular release of late was the 30th Anniversary PlayStation collection . With the Prism Collection, the design team appears to be doubling down on audience demand for retro designs that tap into nostalgia for classic gaming eras.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼正拓展硬件联名的范围，例如与韩国流行音乐明星Lisa合作推出新款DualSense手柄。不过，近期最受欢迎的产品还是PlayStation 30周年纪念系列。如今推出Prism系列，设计团队似乎希望进一步满足玩家对复古设计的需求，唤起他们对经典游戏年代的怀念。

paragraphs.en: PlayStation as a whole continues to be embroiled in controversies stemming from Sony's decision to cut disc production as well as a number of studio closures . Despite the backlash, Sony saw a 22% increase in PS5 sales during the past month, likely tied to the release of Insomniac’s Wolverine and the lead-up to GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼决定削减光盘产量，加上多家工作室关闭，让PlayStation整体仍深陷争议。尽管遭到批评，过去一个月PS5销量仍增长了22%，这可能与Insomniac的《金刚狼》发售，以及《GTA6》发售前的热度有关。

paragraphs.en: Phantom Blade Zero is the next ( sort of ) PlayStation exclusive set to hit consoles, and according to our reviewer, it’s looking pretty darn good .
paragraphs.cn: 《影之刃零》将是下一款登陆主机的PlayStation独占游戏——某种程度上算是独占。据我们的评测编辑所说，这款游戏看起来相当不错。
